$comment: The eight ward archetypes, from docs/ecosystem/23-tessera.md §2.4 and §6.1.
CANONICAL. doc 23 §6 says the trees live as JSON in THIS repository so the engine and the art
prompts read the same file and cannot drift — the Emberkin pattern (19-new-products.md:86).
micro-tessera does not exist yet; when it does it reads this file rather than restating it.
That inversion is what micro-aetherholm-assets got wrong in the other direction and had to
record in its README: two content sources is the drift defect this estate keeps paying for.
`description` is the substitution in the plate prompt template quoted at §2.4, verbatim.
`horizon` is the substitution in the backdrop template. `light` is the time-of-day clause.
PLATES, not tiles. A plate is a flat-on painterly material sheet: diffusion cannot hold an
isometric seam, so the seam is produced by project_iso.py from a plate that never had to tile.
Four plates per ward x eight wards = 32 generations; twelve tiles per ward x eight = 96

platePhrase.verge: the verge where the path meets the ground, edged

$tiles: Twelve derived tiles per ward, cut and projected from that ward's four plates by
project_iso.py. ground-a and ground-b are cut from DIFFERENT REGIONS OF THE SAME PLATE so the
ground varies without a second generation — §2.5. This is where painterly earns its keep:
two cuts of one painting agree with each other and two vector tiles would not.
`from` names the plate each tile is cut from; `region` is the normalised (x, y) centre of the
cut within that plate, so two tiles off one plate are provably different pixels.

wards.name: Ashfield
wards.description: warm grey volcanic grit, ember-lit, fine cinder and scattered basalt chips, the founding ward
wards.horizon: a low volcanic plain of warm grey cinder under a bank of ash cloud, with the founding ward's chimneys and lantern lines strung across the middle distance and one ember glow banked at the horizon

wards.name: Terrace
wards.description: cut stone steps and planted ledges climbing a slope, dry-laid limestone risers, moss in the joints
wards.horizon: a hillside of cut stone terraces climbing away in shallow steps, planted ledges spilling green over their edges, dwellings set into the slope and a warm haze in the cut of the valley

wards.name: Wharf
wards.description: salt-bleached boards over dark water, rope, tar and iron cleats, weathered pale silver-grey timber
wards.horizon: a working waterfront of salt-bleached boardwalk and pilings over dark water, moored hulls and a forest of rope and mast, warehouse fronts behind and a wide flat estuary beyond

wards.name: Undercroft
wards.description: vaulted brick beneath the city, lamplit, no sky, damp red brick and worn flagstone
wards.horizon: a vaulted brick undercroft running away into lamplit dark, ribbed arches repeating into the distance, no sky anywhere, water standing bright between the flags

wards.name: Glasshouse
wards.description: iron frame and green glass, condensation, hot light, riveted ironwork and pale gravel underfoot
wards.horizon: the inside of a vast iron-and-glass house, green panes fogged with condensation, hot light coming down through the ribs of the roof, planting beds running away in rows

wards.name: Kilnyard
wards.description: fired clay, brick stacks, heat shimmer, terracotta dust and scorched firebrick, the maker's ward
wards.horizon: a yard of bottle kilns and stacked firebrick under heat shimmer, terracotta dust in the air catching the light, a working ward with smoke leaning off the stacks

wards.name: Grove
wards.description: deep loam, moss, filtered canopy light, leaf litter and exposed root over dark soil
wards.horizon: deep woodland of tall trunks with light filtering down through a high canopy, moss and leaf litter on the floor, a clearing opening into warm light at the middle distance

wards.name: Saltflat
wards.description: cracked white pan, mineral crust, huge flat sky, polygonal salt plates over pale grey clay
wards.horizon: an immense cracked white salt pan running flat to a very distant horizon under an enormous sky, mineral crust catching low light, one thin line of structures far off

timeOfDay.day: flat even daylight, high sun, the ward's own colours at full strength
timeOfDay.dusk: low warm ember light raking in from one side, long cool shadows, the sky burning down to ash at the horizon
timeOfDay.night: lamplight only — warm pools of lantern light against deep cool blue dark, the sky black and the ward reading by its own lights
